linux.title: 3. Connect Robot To Cloud
linux.desc: Send your robot's questions straight to your rented cloud server:
linux.code:
import requests

POD_IP = 'https://YOUR_POD_ID-11434.proxy.runpod.net'
response = requests.post(f'{POD_IP}/api/generate', json={
    'model': 'llama3.3:70b',
    'prompt': 'Deskbot companion brain query: Summarize today.'
})
print(response.json()['response'])

name: ElevenLabs Voice AI
pro: Indistinguishable from real humans, expresses emotion, and speaks instantly
con: Requires internet connection and an account

linux.title: 1. Install Sound Player
linux.code:
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y mpv
pip install elevenlabs

linux.title: 2. Speak Text to Speaker
linux.desc: Send text and play audio directly through your speakers:
linux.code:
from elevenlabs.client import ElevenLabs
from elevenlabs import stream

client = ElevenLabs(api_key='YOUR_API_KEY')
audio = client.generate(text='System online, all motors calibrated!', voice='Rachel')
stream(audio)

macos.title: 1. Install Mac Audio
macos.code:
brew install mpv
pip3 install elevenlabs

name: Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB)
pro: Has pins to connect cameras, microphones, sensors, and motor boards directly
con: A bit slow for running giant AI brains entirely on its own

specs.interface: Pin Header, Camera Port, Display Port
specs.wiring: Pin 1 (3.3V Power), Pin 2/4 (5V Power), Pin 6 (Ground), Pin 3 & 5 (Data Wires)
specs.tip: Use the official 27W power adapter so the board doesn't reboot when motors turn on.

name: Beelink SER8 Mini PC
role: Compact Quiet Desk Server (Runs Big AI Models)
pro: Compact, quiet mini PC that runs smart 8B and 14B models on your desk without lag
con: Higher upfront cost than simple hobby boards

specs.interface: USB Ports, Fast Network Cable Port, Wi-Fi
specs.wiring: Connects to your home Wi-Fi or directly to your robot via network cable
specs.tip: Set aside 8GB to 16GB of shared memory in the setup menu so AI models load smoothly.

name: Mac Mini M4 (24GB)
pro: Fast unified memory runs huge 14B to 32B models completely silently with zero fan noise
con: Cannot upgrade memory after buying

specs.interface: Thunderbolt / USB-C Ports, Fast Network Port
specs.wiring: Acts as your home companion server over Wi-Fi
specs.tip: Use Apple's native MLX software to get the fastest possible talking speeds.

name: ESP32-S3 Microcontroller
pro: Tiny, cheap, has built-in Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, and controls motors and lights directly
con: Too small to hold large language models inside it
aliSearchQuery: ESP32-S3 Dev Board N16R8 Octal PSRAM

specs.power: Powered simply through a standard USB-C phone cable
specs.tip: Pick a board that says '8MB PSRAM' if you want it to listen for wake words locally.

name: PCA9685 Motor Driver Board
role: Motor Controller (Moves 16 Servos Using Only 2 Wires)
runs: Connects to ESP32 or Raspberry Pi
pro: Controls up to 16 head and arm motors smoothly without jittering
con: Requires its own 5V power wire for the motors

specs.power: Separate 5V 3A power wire for the motors
specs.wiring: Data Wire 1 -> GPIO 21 | Data Wire 2 -> GPIO 22 | Ground -> Common Ground
specs.tip: NEVER power motors directly from the computer chip; always use a separate 5V battery or wall plug on the screw terminals.

name: Round Screen (Eyes & Face)
role: Circular Color Screen For Animated Eyes
runs: Connects to ESP32 or Raspberry Pi
pro: Round shape looks like a real robotic eye or face and supports smooth blinking animations
con: Takes a few jumper wires to connect
aliSearchQuery: Waveshare 1.28 inch Round Touch LCD GC9A01

specs.wiring: Data -> Pin 23 | Clock -> Pin 18 | Screen Select -> Pin 5 | Reset -> Pin 4
specs.tip: Use the LovyanGFX graphics library for super-smooth 60 frames-per-second eye movements.

name: ReSpeaker Dual-Microphone Hat
role: Directional Ears (Plugs Right Onto Raspberry Pi)
runs: Plugs into Raspberry Pi top pins
pro: Hears your voice across the room clearly and includes a built-in speaker amplifier
con: Made specifically for Raspberry Pi pin headers

specs.interface: Plugs directly on top of the Raspberry Pi header
specs.power: Takes power automatically from the Pi
specs.wiring: Zero wiring needed - pushes straight onto the top pins
specs.tip: Adjust the volume in your sound settings to ~80% so the microphones don't distort loud speech.

name: INMP441 Micro Digital Mic
pro: Crisp digital sound with zero buzzing or background static for under $4
con: Requires careful 3.3V wiring

specs.wiring: Clock -> Pin 14 | Word Select -> Pin 15 | Data -> Pin 32 | Ground -> Ground
specs.tip: Keep the connection wires short (under 10cm) to keep the audio crystal clear.

name: MAX98357A Mini Speaker Amplifier
runs: Connects to ESP32 or Raspberry Pi
pro: Combines a digital sound converter and 3-watt speaker amplifier into a coin-sized board
con: Mono output (powers one speaker)

specs.power: 5V Power rail for crisp, full volume
specs.wiring: Bit Clock -> Pin 26 | Word Clock -> Pin 25 | Audio Data -> Pin 22
specs.tip: Connect to any 4-ohm or 8-ohm small speaker for clear voice output.

name: MG90S Metal Gear Micro Servos
pro: Strong metal internal gears won't strip or break when nodding and shaking the head
con: Small motor hum when moving heavy robot parts

specs.wiring: Brown Wire: Ground | Red Wire: 5V Power | Orange Wire: Signal Pin
specs.tip: Add a small capacitor across the 5V power wires to stop the board from resetting when motors start moving.

name: ESP32-CAM Camera Board
pro: Tiny $7 camera board with built-in Wi-Fi to track faces and look at objects
con: Needs a steady 5V power source
aliSearchQuery: ESP32-CAM OV2640 Camera Module with CH340 Downloader

specs.interface: Camera ribbon on board + USB adapter
specs.wiring: Comes with USB plug adapter for effortless programming
specs.tip: Make sure you use a 2-amp phone charger; weak cables cause the camera to reboot when sending video.

name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3
runs: Plugs into Raspberry Pi ribbon port
pro: Crisp 12-megapixel camera with fast autofocus so your bot can read text and recognize your face
con: Requires a Raspberry Pi board

specs.wiring: Slide ribbon into the camera slot on your Raspberry Pi board
specs.tip: Works out of the box with standard Python programs for facial tracking.

name: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 Sense
pro: Smaller than a postage stamp yet packs a full camera, microphone, and Wi-Fi on board
con: Very small pin connections
aliSearchQuery: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 Sense Camera Mic

specs.power: Standard 5V phone charger or small rechargeable battery
specs.wiring: Camera and microphone snap on top without needing jumper wires
specs.tip: The number one choice for tiny 3D-printed robot heads where room is tight.

name: Distance & Hand-Wave Sensor
role: Proximity Sensor (Notices When You Sit At Your Desk)
runs: Connects to ESP32 or Raspberry Pi
pro: Uses an invisible laser to detect when you sit down so your companion can wake up and say hello
con: Needs a clear open hole in your robot case
aliSearchQuery: VL53L0X Time of Flight Distance Sensor Module I2C

specs.wiring: Power -> 3.3V | Ground -> Ground | Clock -> Pin 22 | Data -> Pin 21
specs.tip: Use this to trigger your robot to look up and say 'Good morning!' whenever you walk into your office.

name: WS2812B RGB Glow Ring
pro: Lights up different colors to show when the bot is listening, thinking, or talking
con: Can be very bright at full power

specs.tip: Dim the software brightness to ~20%—it looks much softer and uses less power.
